Check cuplyr dependencies

Source: R/check-deps.R
check_deps.Rd

Performs a pre-flight check of all dependencies required to install and run cuplyr. Reports status of NVIDIA driver, CUDA toolkit, libcudf, R version, and required R packages.

Usage

check_deps(format = c("text", "json"), verbose = FALSE)

Arguments

format

Output format: "text" for human-readable console output, "json" for machine-readable JSON string.

verbose

If TRUE, print additional details about each check.

Value

Invisibly returns a list with:

ok

Logical: TRUE if all required checks pass

checks

Named list of individual check results, each with ok, value, and message fields

Details

The following checks are performed:

  1. NVIDIA Driver: Verifies nvidia-smi is available and reports the driver version, read with nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version and, failing that, from the Driver Version: or KMD Version: header

  2. CUDA Toolkit: Looks for nvcc in CUDA_HOME, CONDA_PREFIX, the environment of the libcudf that cuplyr has loaded, the pixi environment (PIXI_PROJECT_ROOT, or .pixi in the working directory), the system CUDA directories and PATH, in that order. Validates CUDA >= 12.2 and reports the CUDA version

  3. libcudf: Reports the libcudf that cuplyr has loaded, if any. Otherwise looks for cudf headers and libcudf.so under CUDF_HOME, CONDA_PREFIX, the pixi environment (PIXI_PROJECT_ROOT, or .pixi in the working directory) and standard paths. A CUDF_HOME or CONDA_PREFIX that points to a missing directory is named in the message but does not fail the check by itself. The check reports the libcudf version it finds (from cudf/version_config.hpp) and fails for a libcudf older than 26.02; a version it can't read is not a failure.

  4. R Version: Checks R >= 4.3.0

  5. R Packages: Verifies required R packages are installed

  6. GPU Access: Tests if a GPU device is accessible (if cuplyr is already installed)

See also

verify_installation() for post-install verification, diagnostics() for full system diagnostics

Examples

# Human-readable output
check_deps()
#> cuplyr dependency check
#> -------------------------------------------------- 
#> ✔ NVIDIA Driver: Driver version 615.78.08
#> ✔ CUDA Toolkit: CUDA 13.4 at /opt/cuda
#> ✔ libcudf: libcudf loaded by cuplyr from /home/theo/cuplr/.pixi/envs/default/lib/libcudf.so (libcudf 26.10.2). Note: CUDF_HOME is set to '/home/theo/cuplr/rapids-dev/lib/python3.12/site-packages/libcudf', which does not exist.
#> ✔ R Version: R 4.6.1
#> ✔ R Packages: All 7 required packages installed
#> ✔ GPU Access: GPU accessible: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070
#> -------------------------------------------------- 
#> All checks passed. 
#> Next step: ./configure && R CMD INSTALL .

# Machine-readable JSON
check_deps(format = "json")
#> {
#>   "ok": true,
#>   "checks": {
#>     "nvidia_driver": {"ok": true, "value": "615.78.08", "message": "Driver version 615.78.08"},
#>     "cuda_toolkit": {"ok": true, "value": "13.4", "message": "CUDA 13.4 at /opt/cuda"},
#>     "libcudf": {"ok": true, "value": "/home/theo/cuplr/.pixi/envs/default", "message": "libcudf loaded by cuplyr from /home/theo/cuplr/.pixi/envs/default/lib/libcudf.so (libcudf 26.10.2). Note: CUDF_HOME is set to '/home/theo/cuplr/rapids-dev/lib/python3.12/site-packages/libcudf', which does not exist."},
#>     "r_version": {"ok": true, "value": "4.6.1", "message": "R 4.6.1"},
#>     "r_packages": {"ok": true, "value": "Rcpp, dplyr, rlang, vctrs, cli, tidyselect, tibble", "message": "All 7 required packages installed"},
#>     "gpu_access": {"ok": true, "value": "NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070", "message": "GPU accessible: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070"}
#>   }
#> } 

# Programmatic use
result <- check_deps()
#> cuplyr dependency check
#> -------------------------------------------------- 
#> ✔ NVIDIA Driver: Driver version 615.78.08
#> ✔ CUDA Toolkit: CUDA 13.4 at /opt/cuda
#> ✔ libcudf: libcudf loaded by cuplyr from /home/theo/cuplr/.pixi/envs/default/lib/libcudf.so (libcudf 26.10.2). Note: CUDF_HOME is set to '/home/theo/cuplr/rapids-dev/lib/python3.12/site-packages/libcudf', which does not exist.
#> ✔ R Version: R 4.6.1
#> ✔ R Packages: All 7 required packages installed
#> ✔ GPU Access: GPU accessible: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070
#> -------------------------------------------------- 
#> All checks passed. 
#> Next step: ./configure && R CMD INSTALL .
if (!result$ok) {
  message("Some checks failed. See result$checks for details.")
}
